bagPolicy.summary: Empower Field at Mile High allows clear bags no larger than 12” x 6” x 12” and small bags no larger than 4.5” x 6.5”. Non-clear bags and oversized bags are prohibited.
allowed: Clear bag no larger than 12” x 6” x 12”
Bag no larger than 4.5” x 6.5” with or without a strap
bagPolicy.note: Diapers and wipes may be carried in an approved clear bag, but diaper bags are not permitted.

parking.note: Parking at Empower Field at Mile High is organized into several lots with specific directions provided for each. The Denver Broncos App offers real-time traffic and arrival information, which is recommended for the best experience. Directions may change due to road closures and traffic flow.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Empower Field at Mile High's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: Empower Field at Mile High offers a variety of food and beverage options, including new souvenir and menu items for the playoffs and the 2025 season. Fans can enjoy dietary accommodations and gameday favorites for just $5, with guides available to locate food and beverages by category or level.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: The sensory rooms are located inside Gate 6 on the Lower Concourse (available to all ticketholders) and on the Plaza Level adjacent to Suite 233 (available to suite and club ticketholders only).

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Ticketed guests who leave the building are NOT permitted to re-enter with a previously scanned ticket.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at Empower Field at Mile High. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Empower Field at Mile High. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
